notes:
Adventist congregation on the south-west side. Seventh-day Adventist congregations are in scope for this project. Meeting address confirmed on the church's own homepage, contact page and venue page on 2026-09-10: 6163 S Midvale Park Rd, Tucson, AZ 85746-3225. Coordinates were already verified, so they were left alone (the seed note claiming 'coordinates missing' was wrong and has been corrected here). The contact page also gives a separate mailing address, 934 N Main Ave, Tucson, AZ 85705, which is NOT the worship site - do not plot it. The congregation rents/shares the Midvale Park Rd building; it has been described elsewhere as Desert Dove Christian Church's building.

Pastor: Ranison Kennedy, named as pastor on the church's own contact page. No other preaching elder or associate is named anywhere on the site. Phone 520-661-9787, email maranatha_rur@yahoo.com; contacting the church directly is probably the only way to get sermon media.

Sermon media: NONE found. The WordPress site (adventistchurch.org template) has no sermons section and no YouTube, Facebook, Vimeo or SermonAudio link anywhere in its HTML; the only feed is the empty default WordPress podcast feed at /feed/podcast. Without published sermons this church is effectively unreviewable for now.

WARNING about a near-miss: searching this church surfaces the Tucson Midvale Park Seventh-day Adventist Church, which has YouTube channels (@midvaleparkseventh-dayadve5222 / UC1cEJoT5vDW1EAFS6Iw_-qA) and livestreams on Facebook. That is a DIFFERENT congregation at 2071 W Drexel Rd, Tucson AZ 85746 - similar name, similar zip, different church. Do not attach its video to Maranatha or attribute its preaching to Ranison Kennedy.
